summary: Explains that unreachable hosts are removed from the active host list, and `meta: clear_host_errors` reactivates all hosts so later tasks retry them.
questions: A host went unreachable mid-play, how do I get Ansible to try it again?
Why are later tasks skipping a host that failed to connect?

answer_card.title: Reset unreachable hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
When Ansible can't connect to a host it marks it UNREACHABLE and removes it from the active hosts for the run. Add a `meta: clear_host_errors` task to reactivate all hosts so later tasks try to reach them again:

```yaml
- meta: clear_host_errors
```
